ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: cgltf (Johannes Kuhlmann): a single file glTF 2.0 loader and validator
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: cgltf 1.15 as released upstream, see dependencies/README.txt. The header cgltf.h is unmodified; src/cgltf.c only defines CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION and includes it, which is how the single file library is compiled once.
